title: Create: Hemodynamics
description: A library mod for blood harvesting, with Create
body:
A Create add-on and library that adds a **Blood** fluid and the means to extract it.

To harvest, place a **Basin** or **Item Drain** directly beneath a set of **Crushing Wheels**. When a mob is crushed, blood is deposited into the collector below.

How much blood a mob yields scales with its **max health** and its type:

| Mob category | Blood yield |
|--------------|-------------|
| Animals, Villagers, Piglins | 100% |
| Arthropods, Creepers, Endermen | 50% |
| Zombies | 25% |
| Bogged, Husk | 10% |
| Skeletons, Golems, untagged | none |

All of these are **data-driven tags**, so you can re-tier any vanilla or modded mob.

By default, mobs produce 50mB of blood, per point of max health (configurable)
